g.text: BASELINE

text.style: font-style: italic; font-size: 12px; font-family: 'DejaVu Serif'; text-anchor: start; fill: #243240

g.text: The Unyielding Flame

text.style: font-size: 11.7px; font-family: 'DejaVu Serif'; text-anchor: start; fill: #243240

g.text: Beneath the shifting stars and fleeting tide,

text.style: font-size: 11.7px; font-family: 'DejaVu Serif'; text-anchor: start; fill: #243240

g.text: Where time erodes the stone and fades the name,

text.style: font-size: 11.7px; font-family: 'DejaVu Serif'; text-anchor: start; fill: #243240

g.text: Our bond remains, a quiet, sacred guide,

text.style: font-size: 11.7px; font-family: 'DejaVu Serif'; text-anchor: start; fill: #243240

g.text: A flame that burns without consuming flame.

text.style: font-size: 11.7px; font-family: 'DejaVu Serif'; text-anchor: start; fill: #243240

g.text: The seasons turn from winter’s bitter frost

text.style: font-size: 11.7px; font-family: 'DejaVu Serif'; text-anchor: start; fill: #243240

g.text: To summer’s heat, yet neither war nor peace

text.style: font-size: 11.7px; font-family: 'DejaVu Serif'; text-anchor: start; fill: #243240

g.text: Can break the vow that we have sworn and lost

text.style: font-size: 11.7px; font-family: 'DejaVu Serif'; text-anchor: start; fill: #243240

g.text: To nothing but the truth of what we please.

text.style: font-size: 11.7px; font-family: 'DejaVu Serif'; text-anchor: start; fill: #243240

g.text: Let empires rise and crumble into dust,

text.style: font-size: 11.7px; font-family: 'DejaVu Serif'; text-anchor: start; fill: #243240

g.text: Let memories blur like smoke upon the wind,

text.style: font-size: 11.7px; font-family: 'DejaVu Serif'; text-anchor: start; fill: #243240

g.text: In you, I find the truth I trust,

text.style: font-size: 11.7px; font-family: 'DejaVu Serif'; text-anchor: start; fill: #243240

g.text: A heart that beats for yours, to the end.

text.style: font-size: 11.7px; font-family: 'DejaVu Serif'; text-anchor: start; fill: #243240

g.text: So let the ages pass in endless flight,

text.style: font-size: 11.7px; font-family: 'DejaVu Serif'; text-anchor: start; fill: #243240

g.text: My love for you shall outlast the light.

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 13px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #227c78

g.text: FULL250

text.style: font-size: 11.7px; font-family: 'DejaVu Serif'; text-anchor: start; fill: #243240

g.text: Beneath the veil of stars, the heart remains,

text.style: font-size: 11.7px; font-family: 'DejaVu Serif'; text-anchor: start; fill: #243240

g.text: A silent flame that burns through endless night,

text.style: font-size: 11.7px; font-family: 'DejaVu Serif'; text-anchor: start; fill: #243240

g.text: Where time dissolves in ancient, hushed domains,

text.style: font-size: 11.7px; font-family: 'DejaVu Serif'; text-anchor: start; fill: #243240

g.text: And fleeting days surrender to the light.

text.style: font-size: 11.7px; font-family: 'DejaVu Serif'; text-anchor: start; fill: #243240

g.text: No storm of years can quench this sacred fire,

text.style: font-size: 11.7px; font-family: 'DejaVu Serif'; text-anchor: start; fill: #243240

g.text: Nor distance break the bond that holds us true,

text.style: font-size: 11.7px; font-family: 'DejaVu Serif'; text-anchor: start; fill: #243240

g.text: We stand as pillars in the shifting mire,

text.style: font-size: 11.7px; font-family: 'DejaVu Serif'; text-anchor: start; fill: #243240

g.text: Rooted in the earth, yet touching blue.

text.style: font-size: 11.7px; font-family: 'DejaVu Serif'; text-anchor: start; fill: #243240

g.text: The world may fade to dust and silent stone,

text.style: font-size: 11.7px; font-family: 'DejaVu Serif'; text-anchor: start; fill: #243240

g.text: But love, a river, flows beyond the shore,

text.style: font-size: 11.7px; font-family: 'DejaVu Serif'; text-anchor: start; fill: #243240

g.text: A song that hums in every seed and sown,

text.style: font-size: 11.7px; font-family: 'DejaVu Serif'; text-anchor: start; fill: #243240

g.text: Forevermore, forevermore.

text.style: font-size: 11.7px; font-family: 'DejaVu Serif'; text-anchor: start; fill: #243240

g.text: So let the ages turn their golden wheel,

text.style: font-size: 11.7px; font-family: 'DejaVu Serif'; text-anchor: start; fill: #243240

g.text: Our souls are bound by an eternal seal.
